name: List Linkable Objects
summary: Lists the object types a custom object can be linked to (Lead, Company, and your other custom objects) and the link fields — used for one-to-many/many-to-many designs.
whenToUse: When modeling relationships (e.g. a Car linked to a Lead) and you need the allowed target objects and their link fields.

response.description: Linkable objects (Lead, Company, custom types) with their link fields.
